subject: [PATCH v2 08/17] selftests/mm: add khugepaged completion barrier helper

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a helper function to the selftests/mm module that allows tests to drive the khugepaged daemon in a controlled manner. The helper, called thp_update_num(), writes sysfs knobs only when their values change, preventing unnecessary wake-ups of the daemon. This is necessary because settings pushes must not start scan passes without explicit permission from the caller. The patch also introduces a new function, khugepaged_full_pass(), which drives the daemon in step and waits for full scans to advance by two. This allows tests to check the result of a full scan pass.
